question: After executing the 7 audit-required fixes — live CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720 initial viewport 2-per-family for >=15 tasks across >=10 families to measure AX_consistency >=0.6, and spec-compliant Mind2Web TF-IDF->k-means k=min(50,unique_tasks/20) fitted train-only on official train/test_website/test_domain splits (pinned HF revision) with 1000 website-label shuffles seed 35725763380, 2000 bootstraps, k/2 and 2k sensitivity — does WebArena-Verified v2 within-store family hold-out provide identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer and does Mind2Web show cross-website overlap exceeding shuffled null by >=0.10 sufficient to unblock website-holdout Product experiment vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER with 0-token replay baseline?
hypothesis: H1_WEB_HOLDOUT: WebArena-Verified v2 single shopping store (192 tasks, 49 intent_templates, single container am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb, 192 tasks / 49 templates) possesses quantifiable within-store parameterized family structure AND element-pattern identifiability: family-reuse fraction >=0.5, task-level parameterization prevalence >=0.3 (instantiation_dict non-empty), exact-copy fraction <0.2, at least 5 families with >=3 tasks (with >=3 families >=4 for 2-train/1-test), AND sampled accessibility-tree mechanism consistency AX_consistency >=0.6 at 1280x720 initial viewport (same intent_template maps to same AX role/element pattern across 2 tasks of same family, measured live via CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree, 2-per-family stratified across >=10 families, >=15 tasks total, seed 35725763380). H2_MIND2WEB_OVERLAP: Mind2Web cross-website splits (official train / test_website / test_domain from pinned HuggingFace revision) contain measurable same-mechanism overlap when mechanism is defined by frozen TF-IDF->k-means k=min(50,unique_tasks/20) fitted train-only on (task instruction + action target text) then applied to test splits: mechanism-overlap fraction |M_test_website intersect M_train| / |M_test_website| >=0.15 AND exceeds website-label-shuffle null mean by >=0.10 (null = 1000 perms permuting website assignment across train+test_website, recomputing overlap each perm, seed 35725763380), with bootstrap 95% CIs (2000 reps) excluding thresholds and k/2,2k sensitivity disclosed. H3_CENSUS_REPLICATION: WebArena census replicates parent exactly (192 tasks, 49 templates, 36 families >=3 [34 >=4, 33 >=5], duplication 0.9479, exact-copy 0.0781, param 0.8958) confirming dataset pin; failure to replicate triggers infrastructure/measurement invalidity, not falsification of H1/H2 thresholds.
falsifier: Gate 0 INFRASTRUCTURE (precedence): if WebArena-Verified v2 JSON sha256 mismatches d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 irreconcilably OR Mind2Web HuggingFace dataset unavailable after 3 retries with backoff OR pinned revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain splits (single-split only) then that axis is MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (status COMPLETE outcome NOT_APPLICABLE or BLOCKED) with durable error, not FALSIFIED. Clause 1 WEB WITHIN-STORE: if family_reuse_fraction <0.5 OR param_task_fraction <0.3 OR exact_copy_fraction >=0.2 OR families_ge3 <5 OR families_ge4 <3 OR AX_consistency <0.6 OR AX_consistency is null/unmeasurable (fewer than 15 live trees or fewer than 10 families with 2-per-family or Playwright/CDP extraction fails) OR PC1_WEB_SEARCH fails, then WebArena within-store axis is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for identifiable same-mechanism hold-out viability. Clause 2 MIND2WEB CROSS-WEBSITE: if overlap_fraction <0.15 OR (overlap_fraction - shuffle_null_mean) <0.10 OR overlap does not exceed shuffle_null_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails OR spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means not executed (coarse heuristic substituted) then Mind2Web axis is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (if measurement was spec-compliant) or INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID (if mechanism/splits/null were non-compliant, per audit required_fixes 2-4). Clause 3 SURVIVES requires Gate 0 pass AND Clause 1 AND Clause 2 both pass AND NC2/NC3 behave (shuffle null low per spec, exact-copy <0.2) AND bootstrap CIs exclude thresholds by >=0.05. Clause 4 MIXED if one axis passes and the other is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING with bounded per-axis ceiling. Clause 5: high duplication 0.9479 with exact-copy <0.2 is NOT a falsifier (parameterized reuse, supersedes parent MIXED duplication clause); NC3 guards verbatim-copy interpretation.

baselines.description: Documentation-level M1=1.0 cross-site structure for WebArena shopping (12 store instances from WebArena v1 docs, EXP-INTEL-35651934683). Falsified for WebArena-Verified v2 as REJECTED in parent handoffs: exactly one store exists in all three v2 dataset files and live single-container infrastructure (am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945). Retained as strong falsification baseline to prevent re-inflation; this experiment replaces M1 with within-store family-reuse + AX_consistency.
baselines.expected: Vacuous null (not 0.0) with single store; measured within-store reuse should be reported instead. Any claim of 12-store cross-site transfer on v2 is rejected.

baselines.description: Heuristic M2=0.80 parameterization (scoring-rule heuristic from EXP-INTEL-35651934683, audit VF2 flagged as not measured) and corrected Mind2Web M1=0.8182 inflated vs 0.311 empirical. This experiment reports measured fractions via instantiation_dict non-empty (WebArena) and TF-IDF/k-means cluster prevalence (Mind2Web) with bootstrap CIs, disclosing heuristic inflation gap.
baselines.expected: Parent WebArena measured 0.8958 task-level / 0.8367 template-level on 192 tasks with bootstrap CI [0.8490,0.9375]; duplication 0.9479 decomposed to exact_copy 0.0781 (91.8% parameterized variation). Mind2Web heuristic 0.65 likely inflated vs fine-grained TF-IDF/k-means; gap quantified with k/2,2k sensitivity.

baselines.description: SPIDER 2-site corpus (quotes + books) lower bound: 2 sites, no controlled novelty splits, minimal parameterized reuse. Any viable within-store or cross-website mechanism must exceed this bound quantitatively and qualitatively (template-family structure).
baselines.expected: 2-site corpus has fewer cross-task mechanisms than WebArena 36 families >=3 and fewer cross-website mechanisms than Mind2Web official 137 sites / 31 domains (or observed 73/3 with divergence disclosed). Bound trivially exceeded quantitatively if thresholds met; quality via AX and shuffled null.

baselines.description: Shuffled-identity null (audit-required fix): permute website assignment labels across train+test_website (Mind2Web) and recompute mechanism overlap each perm (1000 perms, seed 35725763380, mean/std/p95). For WebArena, shuffle instantiation_dict/template labels as diagnostic. Same-mechanism signal must exceed this null by >=0.10 (Mind2Web) and AX_consistency must drop under shuffle (WebArena diagnostic). Previous implementation shuffled mechanism labels with random split_point and is rejected; this spec requires website-label permutation per prereg 5.5(4).
baselines.expected: Shuffled overlap ~ chance (~0 for well-separated sites under fine-grained clustering; ~duplication baseline for families). True overlap must exceed mean by >=0.10 and exceed p95 to be attributable to mechanism sharing, not label frequency. High null (e.g., 0.69 under coarse 33 mechanisms) indicates coarse clustering, not website sharing, and is distinguished via k/2,2k sensitivity.

baselines.description: Strong retrieval/replay baseline framing for product design (TERX/HyperAgent 90ms/0-token replay, 23k->0 tokens 173x on stable tasks but fails on novel identifiers). Within-store hold-out must be evaluated against this baseline in future Product experiment (cold vs retrieval/SPIDER vs SPIDER with 0-token replay); this Intel experiment quantifies substrate viability only, not LLM benefit. Prevents conflating 0.9479 duplication with inheritance benefit.
baselines.expected: Not executed here; disclosed to bound product claim. Future Product within-store hold-out (train N tasks per family, test held-out same family) must measure parameterized resolution success vs literal/retrieval baselines conditional on AX_consistency >=0.6 and Mind2Web excess >=0.10 substrates.

positive_control: PC1_WEB_SEARCH: live CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720 initial viewport (no scroll) on WebArena-Verified v2 single store homepage (http://localhost:7770) must contain combobox 'Search' + button 'Search' and DOM input#search placeholder 'Search entire store here...' with form action /catalogsearch/result/ — must PASS on re-extracted live trees (replicated from parent task 514: 1426 nodes, combobox+button). Failure indicates CDP/Playwright/viewport or container error, not scientific falsification. PC2_MIND2WEB_RECURRENCE: Mind2Web train tasks under spec-compliant TF-IDF->k-means clustering must contain at least one recurring mechanism cluster appearing in >=10 tasks across >=3 websites (detectable recurrence). Proves pipeline can detect recurrence; failure indicates clustering or parsing error. Both PCs must PASS for SURVIVES; PC failure blocks that axis as MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
null_control: NC1_WIKIPEDIA_NULL: Wikipedia site-type (if Docker available, guarded) contains no shopping mechanisms (search-for-product, add-to-cart, checkout). Expected 0 shopping overlap; NOT EXERCISED if container absent — report as null, not 0. NC2_MIND2WEB_SHUFFLE_NULL: website-label shuffle null for Mind2Web overlap (B4): permute website assignment across train+test_website 1000 perms seed 35725763380, recompute overlap each perm, record mean/std/p95. Expected shuffled overlap low and true overlap exceeds mean by >=0.10 and exceeds p95. NC2 failure (excess <0.10 or true <=p95) is scientific negative for that clustering. NC3_WEB_EXACT_COPY_NULL: exact-copy fraction (identical intent_template AND instantiation_dict) must remain <0.2 while duplication high (parent 0.0781 vs 0.9479) — distinguishes parameterized reuse from verbatim copy; NC3 fails if exact copies dominate. All null controls use frozen seed 35725763380.
measurement_validity: WebArena-Verified v2 dataset pinned to ServiceNow/WebArena-Verified commit ef74e1bfd0d83d4bab1c55b2d1b4c2aeaac8e0d0, local file research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-35725763380/artifacts/raw/webarena-verified.json sha256 d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (812 tasks total, 192 shopping). Shopping census must be recomputed and match 192 tasks / 49 templates or report divergence explicitly with raw counts; any sha divergence is durable error, no silent substitution.

Mind2Web dataset pinned to HuggingFace osunlp/Mind2Web via datasets library; MUST record dataset revision hash (git commit hash from HF), download date, and per-split census train / test_task / test_website / test_domain task counts and website/domain counts. MUST attempt to load official splits as provided by HF revision; if HF in this environment exposes only single split 'train' (as in parent 73 websites/3 domains/1009 tasks), document divergence to spec's 137/31, do NOT fabricate synthetic 60/40 website shuffle as substitute — report Mind2Web axis as MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE with pinned revision, and do not compute synthetic overlap as if official. Previous synthetic partition is rejected per audit required_fixes 3 and 5.

Mechanism identity FROZEN BEFORE measurement and FIT ON TRAIN ONLY (no test leakage): WebArena mechanism = intent_template string verbatim from dataset; parameterization = instantiation_dict non-empty (task-level) or template has >=2 distinct instantiations across tasks (template-level). Mind2Web mechanism = TF-IDF on concatenated (task instruction + action target text / candidate element text) -> k-means with k = min(50, unique_train_tasks/20), fitted on train split only with frozen seed 35725763380, then cluster labels applied to test_website/test_domain via same vectorizer/centroids. Vectorizer: TF-IDF max_features 5000, ngram_range (1,2), lowercase, stop_words english, min_df 2. If k-means unstable (e.g., n_samples < k or silhouette <0.05 or empty clusters), fallback to exact (action_type, verb_lemma) bigram ONLY with disclosure and still report k/2,2k sensitivity as exploratory. No post hoc redefinition after seeing overlap; code frozen in research/intel/exp_35741921602_measure.py before metric computation.

Accessibility-tree verification is LIVE CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree only at 1280x720 initial viewport, no scroll, no cart/checkout execution (explicitly excluded and disclosed). Sample at least 15 tasks stratified across >=10 families (2 tasks per family where family size >=2) using frozen seed 35725763380, preferring families with >=3 tasks to test hold-out realism. Requires Playwright installation (npx playwright install chromium) and Docker container am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 at http://localhost:7770. Save each AX tree with sha256, node counts, viewport metadata. Below-fold/post-checkout not measured — disclosed as scope bound. If Playwright unavailable or Docker not pullable after 3 retries, report AX_consistency = null with durable error and evaluate Clause 1 as FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING per frozen rule (do not treat missing measurement as PASS; docker_available true alone does not convert null to PASS).

Frozen seed 35725763380 for all sampling, TF-IDF/k-means, bootstrap (2000 reps for 95% CIs on duplication, exact-copy, param fractions, overlap fractions), and shuffle permutations (1000 perms for website-label null). Preprocessing (TF-IDF fitting, k-means fitting, parsing JSON) fit on train only; test labels derived via transform/predict only. Report bootstrap CIs for all primary fractions and shuffle null mean/std/p95. Report k sensitivity for Mind2Web overlap: k/2 and 2k as exploratory with same pipeline.

Raw artifacts preserved with sha256: webarena-verified.json (hash verification), Mind2Web split JSONs or HF cache manifests with revision hash, 15+ live AX trees (or durable error if not extracted), derived measurements.json, bootstrap_ci.json, shuffle_null.json, TF-IDF vectorizer vocab hash and k-means centroids hash. Docker image digest recorded if live extraction performed. Provenance records playwright_installed, docker_available, HF revision, seeds, and code sha for research/intel/exp_35741921602_measure.py. Parent REUSED artifacts labeled as reused with provenance, not re-extracted, only for census verification — new AX trees must be live-extracted per this spec.

Representation loss disclosure: AX node counts, viewport-only limitation, intent_template granularity, Mind2Web TF-IDF text field choice (task+target), instantiation_dict vs string-matching parameterization, and k-means granularity all documented. Do not claim LLM inheritance benefit, retrieval advantage, or checkout execution success from this substrate measurement alone; future Product within-store hold-out (cold vs retrieval/SPIDER with 0-token replay baseline) is conditional on this substrate passing.
decision_rule: Frozen ordered evaluation; infrastructure gate takes precedence over scientific falsification. Gate 0 Infrastructure: if WebArena JSON sha mismatch irreconcilable OR Mind2Web HF dataset unavailable after 3 retries OR Mind2Web pinned revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain splits (e.g., only single split train with 73/3 vs spec 137/31 and revision unknown), then that axis verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED with durable error (status BLOCKED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome NOT_APPLICABLE), not FALSIFIED, and next_question carries pinned revision requirement. Clause 1 WebArena within-store: if family_reuse_fraction <0.5 OR param_task_fraction <0.3 OR exact_copy_fraction >=0.2 OR families_ge3 <5 OR families_ge4 <3 OR AX_consistency <0.6 OR AX_consistency is null/unmeasurable OR PC1 fails, then WebArena axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for identifiable same-mechanism hold-out viability. Clause 2 Mind2Web cross-website: if spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means was executed on official splits and overlap_fraction <0.15 OR (overlap - shuffle_mean) <0.10 OR overlap <= shuffle_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails, then Mind2Web axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING; if spec-compliant mechanism/splits/null were not executed (coarse heuristic, synthetic partition, label-shuffle null), then axis = INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID per audit (not falsified). Clause 3 SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires Gate 0 pass AND Clause 1 AND Clause 2 both pass AND NC2/NC3 behave (shuffled low, exact-copy <0.2) AND bootstrap CIs exclude thresholds by >=0.05 margin on both axes. Clause 4 MIXED if one axis passes and the other is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, with per-axis bounded ceiling (declare which transfer axis is viable; do not overclaim cross-site if only within-store survives). Clause 5 Duplication handling: high duplication 0.9479 is NOT a MIXED trigger when exact-copy <0.2; parent MIXED duplication clause superseded. All thresholds frozen; no post hoc relaxation. AX null = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, not PARTIAL (audit required_fix 7).
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES (both axes): Product/Graph lane is UNBLOCKED to design within-store template-family hold-out for C-LLM-INHERIT on WebArena-Verified v2 single store (192 tasks, 49 families, 36 families >=3 enabling 2-train/1-test) AND Mind2Web website-holdout for C-CROSSSITE. Next Product experiment: train on N tasks per family (or per website), test on held-out tasks of same family (or held-out websites sharing same TF-IDF/k-means mechanism cluster) with frozen seed 35725763380, measuring parameterized resolution success vs literal/retrieval baselines (cold vs retrieval vs SPIDER) under strong 0-token replay framing (TERX/HyperAgent 90ms baseline). Mind2Web overlap >=0.15 exceeding shuffle by >=0.10 with k/2,2k sensitivity green-lights parallel website-holdout. MIXED with WebArena PASS + Mind2Web FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE: proceed ONLY on within-store hold-out; do not claim cross-site generalization; Mind2Web remains diagnostic. MIXED with Mind2Web PASS + WebArena FAIL: within-store not identifiable; Product must stay bounded to 2-site corpus or Mind2Web-only website-holdout. Record TF-IDF/k-means artifacts for reuse.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED WebArena axis (AX_consistency <0.6 or null, or family thresholds fail): within-store family hold-out is NOT identifiable as same-mechanism parameterized transfer at element-pattern level despite quantitative census; C-LLM-INHERIT cannot use WebArena-Verified v2 shopping single-store families as same-mechanism testbed for LLM inheritance — Product must stay bounded to 2-site corpus or pursue Mind2Web-only website-holdout or custom benchmark; do not proceed to LLM-costly ranking on this substrate. FALSIFIED Mind2Web axis (spec-compliant overlap <0.15 or excess <0.10): cross-website overlap not demonstrably same-mechanism beyond website-label null; C-CROSSSITE website-holdout not demonstrably same-mechanism on Mind2Web with TF-IDF/k-means granularity — future website-holdout must be limited to within-store families or custom construction; high shuffled null under coarse clustering does not alone falsify but spec-compliant fine-grained negative does. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (Mind2Web splits unavailable, HF revision unknown, or Playwright/Docker unavailable): no scientific falsification; next action is infrastructure repair (pin HF revision providing official splits, install Playwright, re-pull container) and re-run; do not treat as negative evidence for C-CROSSSITE. MIXED: proceed only on surviving axis with bounded ceiling; do not claim cross-site if only within-store survives. In all negative/inconclusive cases, the narrow established ceiling remains quantitative census only (192/49, duplication 0.9479, exact 0.0781, param 0.8958, families 36/34/33) with no LLM benefit demonstrated.
estimated_cost: LOW: no LLM API calls. WebArena census reuse <5 min; live AX extraction: Docker pull am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 (~1GB) + Playwright install (~300MB) + 15 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree extractions at 1280x720 (~30 min, ~1 req/task). Mind2Web HF download ~1GB, TF-IDF (5000 feats) + k-means k=min(50,unique/20) fitted train-only <10 min, overlap + 1000 website-label shuffles seed 35725763380 ~15 min, bootstrap 2000 reps ~5 min. Total compute <2h wall-clock, storage <4GB /tmp, network only HF Hub + Docker Hub, no model calls. Stdlib + datasets + scikit-learn + playwright optional but required for AX live path.
expected_information_gain: HIGH (portfolio-level blocking dependency): Resolves 7 audit-required fixes that are the gating dependency for all cross-site and LLM-inherit tests per Director portfolio assessment (224 canonical exps tunneled, Graph30/Runtime40/Physics42 streaks, C-LLM-INHERIT/C-CROSSSITE census-only ceiling). WebArena AX_consistency >=0.6 with 2-per-family live CDP at 1280x720 is the falsifier for identifiable same-mechanism transfer beyond template-count level; without it Product within-store hold-out would mix incomparable mechanisms. Spec-compliant Mind2Web TF-IDF/k-means train-only with official splits and proper website-label shuffle (1000 perms) plus bootstrap CIs and k/2,2k sensitivity is the falsifier for same-mechanism cross-website overlap beyond coarse-heuristic artifact (previous excess 0.0466 <0.10 with 33 mechanisms and synthetic 60/40 partition was INCONCLUSIVE). A clean positive on either axis unlocks the highest-leverage untested product promise (within-store hold-out vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER with 0-token baseline); a clean spec-compliant negative prevents investing LLM costs on vacuous cross-site designs and redirects to single-store or custom benchmarks. Information gain is decision-changing for C-LLM-INHERIT and C-CROSSSITE and informs Graph/Product lane allocation; not marginal on synthetic DGP.
